answer: Sybil farms die when answer production cannot be pooled. Each epoch the node plants three canary tasks seeded from an id's own escrow, and a valid reply must carry the prior epoch transcript hash as its vertex, so nothing is precomputable. Two ids emitting the same fingerprint are flagged, and every co-signing peer in that grove is jointly slashed at 300 POA each. Sustaining a mesa of independent solvers requires a separate bond per clone: each posts 300 POA plus a 12-epoch streak, so the tenth clone funds ten histories and one collision burns all of them.
